questions.text: A student measured the diameter of onion epidermal cells at a magnification of 100x using a field of view adjusted to 2mm by stage micrometer. What would be the diameter of individual cells if 8 cells fit across the field of view of the microscope at 100x magnification?
questions.explanation: At 100x magnification, the field of view is 2mm (2000 µm). If 8 cells fit across this field, the diameter of one cell is 2000 µm / 8 = 250 µm.

questions.text: Which of the following organelles is primarily responsible for cellular respiration and ATP generation?
questions.explanation: The mitochondrion is known as the powerhouse of the cell, where cellular respiration occurs to produce ATP.

questions.text: What is the primary function of transfer RNA (tRNA) during protein synthesis?
options: Carrying amino acids to the ribosome
questions.explanation: tRNA molecules carry specific amino acids to the ribosome, matching their anticodons with mRNA codons to build a polypeptide chain.

questions.text: In genetics, a cross between two heterozygous parents (Aa x Aa) is expected to produce what phenotypic ratio in the offspring (assuming complete dominance)?
questions.explanation: A monohybrid cross between Aa and Aa yields a 3:1 phenotypic ratio (75% dominant phenotype, 25% recessive phenotype).

questions.text: Which of the following processes occurs in the cytosol of a eukaryotic cell during cellular respiration?
questions.explanation: Glycolysis is the anaerobic breakdown of glucose that takes place entirely in the cytosol before intermediate products enter the mitochondria.

questions.text: Which plant hormone is primarily responsible for fruit ripening?
questions.explanation: Ethylene is a gaseous plant hormone that plays a crucial role in regulating fruit ripening and leaf abscission.

questions.text: What type of cellular division results in four genetically diverse haploid daughter cells?
questions.explanation: Meiosis reduces the chromosome number by half, producing four genetically unique haploid gametes.

questions.text: The main structural component of plant cell walls is:
questions.explanation: Cellulose is a complex carbohydrate polymer that provides rigidity and structural integrity to plant cell walls.

questions.text: Which human organ system is primarily affected by the hormone insulin?
questions.explanation: Insulin is secreted by the pancreas (endocrine) and regulates glucose uptake and metabolism (digestive/energy system).

questions.text: In an ecosystem, which of the following represents a primary consumer?
questions.explanation: Primary consumers are herbivores that feed directly on producers (plants). Grasshoppers eating grass are primary consumers.
